Headquartered in Mumbai, Swan is a ₹1,400+ Crore organization delivering innovative IT Infrastructure, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Networking, and Managed Services to leading BFSI, PSU, Enterprise, and Corporate customers. We are technology partners with HP, Cisco, Microsoft, VMware, NetApp, and other global OEMs. About The Role We are looking for an experienced VMware VCF Support L3 Specialist with strong expertise in VMware Cloud Foundation, cloud administration, architecture, and enterprise infrastructure management. The role involves providing advanced L3 technical support, designing and managing VMware Cloud environments, resolving complex infrastructure issues, leading technical escalations, and driving platform stability, performance, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate should have strong experience as a VMware Cloud Administrator, Architect, SME, or Technical Lead, with the ability to manage complex enterprise VMware Cloud Foundation environments. Location: CBD Belapur, Navi Mumbai – Client Site Department: IT Infrastructure Employment Type: Full-Time / Permanent Experience: Minimum 8+ Years of relevant experience in VMware Cloud Administration, Architecture, SME, or Management Working Days: As per business and operational requirements Key Responsibilities Provide advanced L3 technical support for enterprise VMware Cloud Foundation environments. Lead the troubleshooting and resolution of complex and critical VMware Cloud infrastructure issues. Design, implement, administer, and optimize VMware Cloud Foundation environments. Provide expert-level support for VCF components, including: VMware vSphere VMware NSX VMware vSAN VMware SDDC Manager Act as a technical SME for VMware Cloud Foundation architecture, administration, and operations. Lead technical escalations and coordinate with internal teams, customers, OEMs, and technology partners for issue resolution. Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical incidents and implement corrective and preventive actions. Lead capacity planning, performance optimization, availability management, and infrastructure lifecycle activities. Support the planning and execution of VMware infrastructure upgrades, migrations, patching, and technology refresh initiatives. Design and implement solutions to improve platform stability, scalability, security, and operational efficiency. Review existing VMware Cloud environments and recommend architecture and performance improvements. Develop and maintain technical documentation, architecture documents, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and operational standards. Mentor L1 and L2 support engineers and provide technical guidance on complex VMware Cloud issues. Collaborate with infrastructure, networking, storage, security, cloud, and application teams for end-to-end issue resolution. Drive continuous improvement, automation, standardization, and best practices across VMware Cloud operations. Stay updated with the latest VMware Cloud Foundation technologies, features, and industry best practices. Required Skills Strong hands-on experience in VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) administration and support. Minimum 8+ years of experience in VMware Cloud Administration, Architecture, SME, or Management roles. Strong expertise in: VMware vSphere VMware NSX VMware vSAN VMware SDDC Manager Strong understanding of VMware Cloud Foundation architecture and components. Experience in L3 troubleshooting and critical incident resolution. Strong experience in performance monitoring, optimization, and capacity planning. Experience with VMware upgrades, migrations, patching, and lifecycle management. Strong Root Cause Analysis and problem-solving skills. Experience in technical leadership, mentoring, and stakeholder management. Strong documentation and communication skills. Experience working in large-scale enterprise and production environments. Preferred Qualification Any Graduate in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. The Following Certification Is Mandatory VMware Certified Professional (VCP) or VMware Certified Advanced Professional (VCAP) in Data Center, Cloud, or Network technologies. What We Offer Opportunity to work on large-scale VMware Cloud Foundation environments. Exposure to advanced VMware Cloud, virtualization, networking, storage, and data center technologies. Opportunity to work as a technical SME on critical enterprise infrastructure environments. Exposure to complex L3 troubleshooting, architecture, optimization, and transformation initiatives. Opportunity to mentor technical teams and drive infrastructure best practices. Collaborative and technology-driven work environment. Career growth through challenging assignments and continuous learning. Ready to Join Us? If you are an experienced VMware Cloud professional with strong expertise in VMware Cloud Foundation, enterprise architecture, L3 support, and infrastructure leadership, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and become a part of Swan Solutions & Services Pvt. Ltd.

review_candidates.title: Network Monitoring and Observability Engineer
review_candidates.company: Credo InfoTech Private Limited is Now rebranded as "GWC Networks Private Limited"
review_candidates.description: Job Category: NMS & Observability Job Type: Full Time Job Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates Location: On-site Experience Required: 2–5 Years Employment Type: Full-Time Job Summary We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Network Monitoring and Observability Engineer with 2 to 5 years of hands-on experience in deploying, configuring, and managing enterprise monitoring frameworks. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the high availability, performance, and security of our clients’ complex network infrastructures and cloud environments. Key Responsibilities Platform Administration: Deploy, configure, and maintain core Network Management Systems (NMS) and observability tools including SolarWinds, ManageEngine, WhatsUp Gold, Nagios, and Datadog. Proactive Monitoring: Set up comprehensive dashboards, alerts, and threshold configurations for servers, network devices, applications, and cloud services to ensure minimal downtime. Incident Response & Troubleshooting: Rapidly triage, investigate, and resolve network anomalies, performance bottlenecks, and infrastructure outages. Performance Tuning: Optimize data collection, reduce alert fatigue, and refine log/metric collection pipelines across diverse enterprise environments. Collaboration & Documentation: Work closely with engineering and support teams to document standard operating procedures (SOPs), architecture topologies, and resolution playbooks. Requirements & Qualifications Experience: 2–5 years of dedicated experience in network management, systems administration, or observability engineering. Technical Proficiency: Hands-on expertise with at least two or more of the following or similar platforms: SolarWinds ManageEngine WhatsUp Gold Nagios Datadog Core Knowledge: Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, BGP, OSPF) and infrastructure monitoring protocols (Syslog, NetFlow, WMI, SNMP traps). Problem-Solving: Strong analytical capabilities with a proven track record of root-cause analysis and proactive issue mitigation. Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-paced environment. What We Offer Competitive remuneration package. Opportunities for career growth and professional certification support. A collaborative and dynamic work environment. Interested candidates may share their updated resume along with current and expected salary details.
